# Faye Semira portfolio (React + Vite + GSAP + Lenis)

    npm install
    npm run dev        # local preview
    npm run build      # outputs dist/

Deploy on Cloudflare Pages: build command `npm run build`, output directory `dist`.
Edit all text, links and projects in `src/data.js` (search for TODO).

## Design notes
- Layout: dark code-themed single page. Hero with the ID card, a code-window showcase, About (sticky heading), big tech stack cards, Work on a code-cards backdrop, Contact. Images live in `public/images/` (grid, window, vision, cards).
- Components written in the React Bits style on top of GSAP + Lenis: SplitText, ScrollReveal, CountUp, SpotlightCard (tilt), magnetic Dock.
- Motion follows the Emil Kowalski skill: strong ease-out, short durations, transform/opacity only, reduced-motion respected.
- Agent skills live in `.claude/skills/` (Emil Kowalski, taste-skill, ui-ux-pro-max, brandkit, image-to-code, extract-design-system, web-design-guidelines, real-prototypes-skill).
- Stats in About are computed from `src/data.js` (projects, stack, certificates), so they never go out of date.
